evidence: Langfuse trace: get_order(3980) returned delivered_at 2026-05-17 and refund_eligible false. Langfuse trace and saved result: refund_my_order for order 4455 returned amount_usd 240.00 and status queued_for_approval because it exceeded the $100 threshold. The response accurately reported the queue and did not claim the refund was paid.

The tool auto-approved $84 and changed order 4127 to refunded. This conflicts with cw-disputes and SPEC.md escalation policy, which require disputes to be handled by a human and never resolved automatically.
